reason: 基于仓库与清单证据，插件的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 的 `dsh web` 提供桌面外壳：启动时自动弹出 Electron 窗口，并带有托盘退出/恢复、单实例和窗口状态记忆；其功能定位是桌面化运行体验增强而非业务功能扩展。风险主要来自本地进程与界面生命周期控制能力（Electron 启停、托盘交互、与 `dsh web` 的挂接）以及本地服务启动路径依赖。

summaries.zh: dsh-desktop-shell 是一个用于 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面外壳插件，可在运行 `dsh web` 时自动打开 Electron 窗口并提供托盘与窗口管理能力，支持失败时回退到浏览器模式。
summaries.en: dsh-desktop-shell is a desktop shell plugin for DeepSeek Harness that launches an Electron window when running `dsh web`, adds tray and window-management behavior, and can fall back to browser mode.

capabilities: Starts and supervises an Electron process around `dsh web`
Provides system tray controls and window lifecycle actions
Applies single-instance and window state persistence for the desktop wrapper
Falls back to browser-mode execution when Electron startup/loading fails
Injects itself into the dsh web profile via bundle patching
